title: RHOPE: LLM-Augmented Adaptive Experimental Design with Complex Contextual Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.33767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Experimental design allocates limited measurement effort across candidate treatments to learn their expected outcomes. Adaptive designs refine allocations as evidence accumulates, improving estimation and treatment selection. Contextual information can inform these decisions, but exploiting unstructured or high-dimensional context remains challenging. We use large language models (LLMs) to transform complex context into proxy outcomes and propose Residual Horizon Optimization for Prediction-Powered Experimentation (RHOPE), a principled Bayesian adaptive experimentation framework that combines true outcomes with LLM-generated proxy outcomes and formulates finite-batch design as a posterior Markov decision process (MDP). Our methodology uses proxy outcomes in two ways: sample augmentation improves estimation precision, while observing proxies before each allocation decision provides advance information. translated_title: RHOPE：利用大语言模型增强的复杂上下文信息自适应实验设计
translated_abstract: 实验设计将有限的测量资源分配到候选处理方案上，以学习其期望结果。自适应设计会随着证据的积累不断优化分配策略，从而提升估计精度和处理方案的选择效果。上下文信息可以为这些决策提供依据，但如何利用非结构化或高维度的上下文信息仍然具有挑战性。我们使用大语言模型（LLM）将复杂的上下文信息转化为代理结果，并提出了面向预测驱动实验的残差视野优化方法（RHOPE）——一个有原则的贝叶斯自适应实验框架，它将真实结果与LLM生成的代理结果相结合，并将有限批次的设计问题形式化为后验马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。我们的方法通过两种方式利用代理结果：样本增强可以提高估计精度，而在每次分配决策之前观察代理结果则能提供前瞻性信息。合成实验和半合成……
tldr: 该论文提出RHOPE框架，利用大语言模型将复杂上下文信息转化为代理结果，将有限批次自适应实验设计形式化为后验马尔可夫决策过程，并通过样本增强与决策前预观察代理结果两种方式提升估计精度和分配决策效果。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RHOPE, a Bayesian adaptive experimentation framework that uses LLMs to transform complex contextual information into proxy outcomes, formulates finite-batch design as a posterior MDP, and leverages proxies through sample augmentation and pre-decision observation to improve estimation precision and allocation decisions.
